# `todo-comment`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: `markers`

Reports configured task markers, by default `TODO`, `FIXME`, and `XXX`, in line
comments.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Task markers are promises; surfacing them in `check` makes the inventory visible
to CI instead of only to readers of one file.

## When it fires

String contents and generated sources are ignored, and the source suppression
syntax can document intentional markers.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
// TODO: handle the empty case
fn first(items: []const u8) u8 {
    return items[0];
}
```

## Options

Set these in the rule's object in `zig-analyzer.json`, next to `level`:

```json
{
  "lints": {
    "rules": {
      "todo-comment": {
        "level": "warning",
        "markers": ["TODO", "FIXME", "XXX"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- `markers` (default `["TODO", "FIXME", "XXX"]`): the comments that count as
  pending work, a non-empty array of non-empty strings.
